aboutText: QA Engineer with 7+ years balancing Manual and Automation Testing across web, desktop, API, and hardware platforms. Skilled in Functional, Regression, API, Performance, and End-to-End Testing, catching critical defects and creating detailed test plans, test cases, and documentation. Equally experienced architecting automation frameworks integrated with CI/CD pipelines, automating UI and API testing, and leveraging AI-powered tools to accelerate test design and execution. Agile/Scrum collaborator working closely with developers and product owners, remote-first, and fluent in English.
